data.plain_english: Technology companies tied to artificial intelligence have risen strongly lately, but interest rates on government borrowing have jumped to their highest levels in many years. The council thinks tech may keep doing somewhat well, but members disagree sharply because higher interest rates and big price swings could quickly reverse those gains. Banks and real estate are expected to do worse because they are most hurt by higher interest rates, while energy is seen as a toss-up. This is research to help you think, not advice to buy or sell any stock, including Nvidia.
